scope: Fifth photographic increment: reusable versioned layer looks, durable library, temporary trial and independent append to the current photo. Partial reuse work across the CL plan; no complete CL/SF/R gate claim.
implemented: Look version 1 captures selected photographic layers in source stack order, with independent layer/mask UUIDs and editable unlocked copies. Operators, resolved numerical parameters, visibility and per-layer opacity are preserved.

Masks are excluded by default and require explicit capture/use choices. Levels analysis provenance is removed without changing resolved values. RAW engine/WB, historical base, crop/geometry, original paths and external assets are outside the look payload.

Applying selected look layers appends independent copies to the destination. Amount 0..100% multiplies each selected layer opacity; zero returns the exact unchanged recipe. Destination base, RAW settings, geometry and existing layers stay intact. Combined recipe quotas are validated before applying any result.

Library schema 5 adds photo_look with a verified pre-migration backup. A single background writer persists creation, revision-checked rename and reversible archive/restore. The collection is included in SQLite backup/restore, with bounds of 128 entries including archived and 48 KiB per payload.

IT/EN saved-look panel with search, per-layer selection, mask choices, intensity, naming and management. The compact inspector exposes looks through Actions, retaining visible Exposure and Before/After controls.

Temporary trial has With/Without comparison, explicit Apply and Cancel/Esc. It leaves the draft, history and confirmed export unchanged until confirmation. Changes to photo/source observation, recipe/look revision or view/inspector context revoke the trial; confirming creates one undoable saved edit.

alpha_fixture.method: Deterministic synthetic raster: u=x/1199; v=y/799; R=.05+.9u; G=.08+.82v; B=.1+.8(.65u+.35v); A=1 for u<=.6, max(0,1-(u-.6)/.3) otherwise. Each component rounded to 8-bit. No user photograph or corpus original modified.

look_actions.scope: Automated service/control workflow, not manual pointer interaction. Reopen, backup restore and Undo/Redo are covered by separate regressions.

native_ui.scope: Native UI with isolated library and generated or explicit source; saved recipe, edited viewer/grid, optional RAW WB and Auto actions. Surface and export scope are reported separately. No universal RAW colour or physical display qualification.

native_visual_review: Italian viewer screenshot inspected: search/list, selected look and layer, intensity, saved-mask choice and Try on photo are visible; management and capture sections are reachable in the same inspector.

Native CLI exercised the actual service/control workflow: save look, trial without history, cancel preserving recipe, confirm as generation 1, saved viewer/grid and PNG16 export. It did not simulate manual pointer input for the whole workflow.

Automated egui interaction regressions cover IT/EN, trial action readiness, Esc, With/Without state, invalidation, one commit, reopen and Undo/Redo. Full manual accessibility and scale campaigns remain open.

limitations: This collection stores supported photographic layer parameters. It does not implement external look/preset import/export, LUT/profile assets, content-aware matching, replacing existing layers, virtual versions or batch application.
Look intensity multiplies each layer opacity, not a raster group blend. Visibility is captured, masks use normalized source-relative coordinates and the destination base affects appearance.
Frozen Auto values are reused without reanalysis. Photo-specific analysis provenance is deliberately absent from portable looks.
Collection quota includes archived entries. Archive/restore is supported; permanent purging is not exposed in this increment.
Temporary trials use the current Preview/Develop context. Confirmed export and saved thumbnails do not include an unconfirmed trial.
Rendering uses the existing canonical CPU operators. GPU in the native report refers to display presentation.
The matrix uses synthetic PNG fixtures; four engine selections do not qualify RAW camera decoding. No calibrated colour/photography, Windows, high-megapixel memory or latency campaign is claimed.
Native visual inspection was Italian. Automated IT/EN checks do not constitute full manual VoiceOver/accessibility or display-scale qualification.
Ad hoc signing and two-XPC qualification do not close release sandbox/assurance gates. Advanced curve variants and later CL packages remain open.
